name: Mailer
description: Email sending through the Resend API: your apps send real mail with your own API key.

credentials.name: api-key
credentials.label: Resend API key (resend.com, free tier works)

operations.name: mail.send
operations.description: Sends an email. Inputs from, to, subject, text; returns {id} on acceptance.

inputs.name: from
inputs.description: Sender, e.g. "App <onboarding@resend.dev>" (resend.dev senders work without domain setup)

operations.howto: Bind from/to/subject/text from inputs (a constant "from" like "My App <onboarding@resend.dev>" is fine); run on a Send button and show the returned id or a sent note. The API key is added once in the part's settings. For a zero-setup alternative, a link element with a mailto: href (format slots build it: mailto:{{value}}?subject={{subj}}) opens the user's own mail app instead.
